svg.title: Cross-section of the spinal cord: neuron 1 carries a pain signal from the skin, past its cell body outside the cord, into the back of the cord, where it synapses onto neuron 2, which crosses the cord and ascends to the somatosensory cortex; a neuron descending from the periaqueductal gray, which releases opioids, makes an inhibitory connection at that synapse.
